display.purpose: Compact page-level task framing, never marketing-scale.

headline.purpose: Decision classifications and major record summaries.

title.purpose: Exhibit subjects, card titles, and section headings.

body.purpose: Descriptions, controls, and recovered source evidence.

label.purpose: Indices, metadata, table headings, and reproducible states.

motion.name: state-color

motion.name: progress-width
motion.purpose: Measured progress changes without decorative motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The decisive action for loading, registering, or advancing evidence work.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--primary); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font: 600 14px/1.2 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2c3e50; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--primary); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A flat secondary action for choosing files or invoking supporting controls.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--card); color: var(--foreground); font: 600 14px/1.2 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: var(--primary); background: var(--surface-low); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-btn-outline:active { background: var(--surface-high); }

components.name: Document Identifier Input
components.description: A compact editable field for reproducible document identifiers.
components.css: .ds-input-id { width: 100%; min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--card); color: var(--foreground); font: 400 12px/1.4 "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-input-id:hover { border-color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input-id:focus-visible { border-color: var(--primary); outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring) 20%, transparent); outline-offset: 0; }

components.name: Active Task Navigation
components.description: The ruled task switcher used for Documents, Fact ledger, and Audit log.
components.html: <nav class="ds-nav" aria-label="Primary navigation"><button class="ds-nav-item ds-nav-item-active" type="button">FACT LEDGER</button><button class="ds-nav-item" type="button">AUDIT LOG</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; min-width: 0; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--card); } .ds-nav-item { position: relative; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--border); background: transparent; color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 600 12px/1.2 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--surface-low); color: var(--foreground); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-nav-item-active { background: var(--card); color: var(--foreground); } .ds-nav-item-active::after { content: ""; position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; height: 2px; background: var(--primary); }

components.name: Verified Status Badge
components.description: A compact, redundant status mark for verified evidence and completed work.
components.css: .ds-status-success { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--verify) 30%, transparent); border-radius: 2px; background: #ecfdf5; color: #065f46; font: 600 10px/1.4 "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.03em; } .ds-status-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; background: currentColor; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-status-success:hover { border-color: var(--verify); } .ds-status-success:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Ledger Card
components.description: The flat bordered container for grouped controls, ledger summaries, and evidence records.
components.html:
FACT SOURCE CONTROLS
Choose a tracked source to load its evidence ledger.
components.css: .ds-card { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--card); color: var(--foreground); } .ds-card-header { padding: 10px 13px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--surface-low); font: 600 10px/1.4 "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.07em; } .ds-card-body { padding: 20px; font: 400 14px/1.55 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: var(--input); } .ds-card:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Selected Ledger Row
components.description: The indexed fact row whose green rule and wash visibly bind it to the source exhibit.
components.css: .ds-ledger-row { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 48px minmax(0, 1fr) 80px; align-items: center; width: 100%; min-height: 54px; padding: 12px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); background: #e7f3ef; color: var(--foreground); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-ledger-row::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; width: 1px; background: var(--verify); } .ds-ledger-row:hover { background: var(--surface-low); } .ds-ledger-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-ledger-index, .ds-ledger-status { color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 600 9px/1.3 "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-ledger-copy { min-width: 0; padding-right: 8px; font: 400 12px/1.4 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-ledger-copy strong, .ds-ledger-copy small { display: block; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-ledger-copy small { margin-top: 2px; color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 11px; } .ds-ledger-status { color: var(--verify); }

components.name: Source Evidence Exhibit
components.description: The signature record that keeps the selected fact attached to the recovered source substring.
components.html:
EXHIBIT 03 · 4BE2D16ANet revenuereported value
PHYSICAL PAGE 14OFFSETS 328–402
“Net revenue increased to 84.2 million for the reporting period.”
components.css: .ds-exhibit { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--card); color: var(--foreground); } .ds-exhibit-header { display: grid; gap: 4px; padding: 12px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--primary); background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); } .ds-exhibit-header span, .ds-exhibit-header small, .ds-exhibit-meta { font: 600 9px/1.4 "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.07em; } .ds-exhibit-header strong { font: 600 16px/1.35 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-exhibit-header small { color: #dbeafe; } .ds-exhibit-meta { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; background: var(--surface-low); } .ds-exhibit-meta span { padding: 8px 12px; border-right: 1px solid var(--border); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); } .ds-exhibit-quote { position: relative; margin: 16px; padding: 20px; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: #fffef8; font: 400 14px/1.75 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-exhibit-quote::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; width: 1px; background: var(--verify); } .ds-exhibit:hover { border-color: var(--input); } .ds-exhibit:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 1px; }

narrative.overview:
Evidence Docket treats every selected fact as an indexed exhibit visibly bound to exact source evidence. The interface feels like a precise working record: mineral paper, deep ink title bands, hairline grids, compact metadata, and small verification marks establish authority without theatrical decoration.

The system is quiet, professional, and deliberately information-dense. One continuous evidence desk preserves the chain from source document to fact ledger, exhibit, and deterministic reasoning; it refuses the generic dashboard pattern of disconnected cards. On mobile, that same chain becomes explicit task tabs rather than a compressed desktop grid.
keyCharacteristics: Mineral-white working surfaces with graphite text and deep-ink anchors.
Hairline grids and compact rows that make provenance relationships visible.
Workhorse sans typography paired with tabular mono metadata.
Verification green, exception amber, and alert red used as semantic evidence states.
Four-pixel core corners and flat, shadowless construction.

rules.name: The Evidence Color Rule
rules.body: Green means verified or actively bound, amber means exception or uncertainty, and red means failure or contradiction; color never decorates neutral structure.

rules.name: The Ink Anchor Rule
rules.body: Deep ink is reserved for headers, decisive actions, and record anchors so every use carries structural weight.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-Evidence Rule
rules.body: Use mono for values that can be indexed, compared, or reproduced; never use it for long explanations or source quotations.

rules.name: The Docket Binding Rule
rules.body: Keep source, claim, exhibit, and reasoning visibly adjacent on desktop; on mobile, preserve their order through task tabs rather than shrinking the full desk into an unreadable grid.

rules.name: The Flat Record Rule
rules.body: Never use ambient shadow to make evidence feel important; hierarchy must come from ink, paper, border, and placement.

rules.name: The Four-Pixel Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Keep persistent workspace geometry at four pixels or less; rounded pills and soft dashboard bubbles do not belong in the docket.

dos: Do keep a selected fact visibly bound to its exact quote, page, offsets, verification state, and confidence.
Do use one-pixel grids, compact rows, and tonal bands to structure dense evidence.
Do reserve mono typography for identifiers, counts, hashes, offsets, tabular values, and reproducible states.
Do preserve the continuous evidence desk on desktop and the ordered task tabs on mobile.
Do pair every semantic color with text, a dot, a border, or another non-color cue.
donts: Don't turn the product into a generic dashboard of disconnected cards.
Don't add shadows, glass effects, glow, gradients, or oversized pill shapes to core evidence surfaces.
Don't use verification green as decoration or let status color replace a readable label.
Don't separate a fact summary from the source exhibit needed to verify it.
Don't loosen the density until provenance relationships no longer fit in the working view.
